question.text: Which information below regarding this reaction is applicable?

options.text: It follows $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 2$ pathway, because it is a primary alkyl chloride.
It follows $S_{N} 1$ pathway, because the intermediate carbocation is resonance stabilized.
$\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 1$ pathway is not followed, because the intermediate carbocation is destabilised by $-1$ effect of oxygen
A mixed $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 1$ and $\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 2$ pathway is followed.

solution.text:
Hint:
$\mathrm{S}_{\mathrm{N}} 2$ is also facilitated by OH due to resonance stablization of transition state.
